verdict.rationale: Apple documents multiple official SDKs for AI-native development on M5 hardware — Metal 4 Tensor APIs for Neural Accelerators, Core ML, MLX (open-source array framework), PyTorch backends via Metal, and the Foundation Models framework — giving developers first-party paths to build AI applications leveraging M5's hardware. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reports of building against these SDKs, and community sentiment notes Apple's ML libraries feel 'insular and disconnected from the rest of the industry' (apple-m5-comm-6), tempering confidence in ecosystem breadth.
